messages.text: can you please confirm magicminer 40t ships from europe so i dont pay any customs/import charges ?

I can't confirm that. The Magic Miner 40T doesn't ship from inside the EU, so the $799 doesn't include import VAT.

If you're in the EU, you'll owe 21% VAT on delivery, plus any import duty. The carrier or customs collects it, not our checkout, and I can't tell you the exact amount your customs office will charge.

Shipping is a separate charge, worked out at checkout.

Which country are you shipping to?
slovenia

For S., the 40T's page says: "21% VAT is not included. Import duties & taxes are the recipient's responsibility."

Slovenian customs usually charges VAT at Slovenia's own rate, which is 22%. As a rough guide, that comes to about $185 on the $799 unit plus $40 shipping. Customs sets the final amount, plus any duty, and you pay it when the parcel is delivered.
